knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Learner information stays on business systems.
An unsafe session is stopped, the tutor leaves in the agreed way, and the stop is recorded.
The location follows the policy and the record.

practicalCriteria: Assessor checks the session set-up record for a home session against the policy
Assessor observes the candidate stop a simulated unsafe session and record the reason
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Session stop record for one simulated stop
Evidence that learner notes are stored on the business system
stopWorkCriteria: The candidate starts a session in a location not agreed in the policy
The candidate keeps learner information on a personal device
The candidate continues an unsafe session
